method: Reviewed every public and assistive catalog value for French meaning, official terms, placeholders and composition around inline titles and links. French L6.2 content and all frozen sources are unchanged. Inspected actual Chromium viewport captures on both bases, at phone and desktop sizes and 100/200 percent text. These are bounded visual, accessibility, keyboard and painted-font checks, not native-speaker, comprehensive accessibility or reader-study proof.
catalogReview: Navigation, selector, appearance, text size, source method and local-data notices
Route/document titles, About, source attribution, edition labels and copyright distinction
Search accent/case handling, paragraphe keyword and empty/loading/failure/retry wording
Saved positions, resume, caller return, removal/undo/reset and live announcements
Concepts, optional foundations, all nine relation labels, trails/endings/reflections
French numeric formatting and dynamic disposition/saved-block labels

commands: MAGNIFICA_RTL_FIXTURE=1 VITE_BASE=/ npx vite build --mode locale-fixture

browserCoverage: 43 French cases at each base, plus accepted English/Italian/German/Spanish regressions
Nine surfaces: Atlas, Concept, Trail, Read, Source, Note, Search, Saved and About
390x844 and 1440x900, 100/200 percent text, reduced motion and keyboard focus
Ordered regional preferences and navigator.language fallback; explicit en/it/de/es URLs override French preferences
Twelve equivalent routes retain query/anchor bytes; switching removes stale caller labels
Saved paragraph and caller restoration, source/note backlinks, French official URLs, local n143 and ibid. dependencies
Failed and cancelled activation preserves exact title and last/recent/visited/nonempty saved fields
Localized search, missing/empty/error/retry states, temporary storage, optional reflections and deferred resources

boundedPolish.change: Shortened French Atlas heading to Explorer les idées and Search heading/title to Chercher after the narrow 200 percent captures split Magnifica/Humanitas and Rechercher within words. No CSS or runtime logic changed.
boundedPolish.detectorTiming: One scan before the heading shortening; final wording checked by complete gates and the bounded visual confirmation.

recoverableFailures.reason: Five new tests expected a short Atlas heading, while the initial French catalog used its full title. The existing unsupported-fr shell probe became an available route and now uses still-unavailable pl. Corrected expectations, no runtime repair; subpath did not run after this failed root attempt.
The translation-difference assertion lacked the legitimate French/English cognate Source {value1}; added it to explicit neutral-key exceptions. No production wording changed for that assertion.

limitations: Chromium viewport automation, not physical-device, screen-reader-user, native-speaker or reader-efficacy studies.
Axe scans and sampled painted nodes do not establish comprehensive accessibility or every possible glyph.
Generated reports, logs, screenshots and fixture outputs remain review evidence outside commit scope; no deployment or publication is claimed.
